summary.text: Michelle Ciccolo is a Democratic state representative from the 15th Middlesex District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is vice chair of the House Committee on Climate Action and Sustainability.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Ciccolo took office on January 2, 2019, succeeding Jay Kaufman in the 15th Middlesex District.
Besides her vice chair role, she serves on the Joint Committees on Aging and Independence, Public Health, and Public Safety and Homeland Security.
